proposed_partner_narrative: Caribbean: DiDi can frame the first/last-mile handoff around two independently verified mass passenger corridors, but the proposal must say corridor traffic—not DiDi-addressable demand—until capture and fare-mix assumptions are approved.

Pacific: position airport and cruise totals only as transfer-pool context. Banderas Bay/Yelapa has actual current water-taxi evidence; Los Cabos Atlas resort routes remain future opportunity without route-level demand.
A safe pilot story is app-to-pier orchestration plus a premium water tier; avoid claiming conversion from airport, cruise or total ferry traffic.
existing_didi_json_audit_notes: Mexico Caribbean and Mexico Pacific markets and all five canonical city IDs are already present in didi.json/network_footprint.

Existing Cancun/Caribbean proof language says tens of millions and continuous high-volume traffic without exact dated URLs; replace with S1/S7 facts plus allocation caveats.
Existing journeys include broad labels/aliases rather than stable BP IDs; geometry and node alias seal is still required.
partner_narrative_notes.finance_handoff_rule: No broad pool conversion. Keep annual_one_way_pax and assumed capture null until owner approves a documented denominator, operator/direction split, realized fare yield, and route-specific capture case.
